title: Smoked Pilaf with Jamaican Potatoes
description: A flavorful rice pilaf dish infused with smoked spices and served with crispy jamaican potatoes.
instructions: Peel and chop the jamaican potatoes into 1-inch cubes. Place on a baking sheet and toss with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and black pepper. Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until crispy.
Cook the smoked pilaf rice according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the smoked paprika and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the garlic powder and onion powder to the skillet and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Fluff the cooked rice with a fork and add to the skillet. Stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Transfer the rice mixture to a serving dish and top with roasted jamaican potatoes. Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro.
